title: been to / gone to / been in

questions.stem: — Where are the girls? — They ____ the playground.

options.distractor: been to 表示人已回来，与“人在哪儿”矛盾
回答去向、说明现在在哪，用完成时

questions.explanation: 问“她们在哪儿”说明人还没回来，用 have gone to。

questions.stem: — ____ you ever ____ to Shanghai? — No, never.

options.distractor: 问“你有没有去过”，人应该在现场
ever（曾经）是完成时的标志词
问的是到目前为止的经历

questions.explanation: ever 与完成时连用，问经历用 Have you ever been to…

questions.stem: My uncle ____ Beijing for ten years.

options.distractor: gone to 表示人还没回来，不能接时间段
been to 表示去过，不表示“待了多久”
for ten years 要用完成时

questions.explanation: “在北京待了十年”用 has been in + 时间段。

questions.stem: — I can't find Mike anywhere. — He ____ to the teachers' office.

options.distractor: been 表示已经回来了，那现在应该找得到他
这里要说明他现在不在这儿的去向

questions.explanation: 找不到人说明他去了别处还没回来，用 has gone。

options.text: He has been to London three times.
She has gone to the shop. She'll be back soon.
We have gone to the museum twice.
They have been in this city for years.

questions.explanation: 讲“去过两次”要用 been to：We have been to the museum twice。

questions.stem: — How many times ____ you ____ to Beijing? — Twice.

options.distractor: 问次数说明人在现场、讲的是经历
问“到目前为止去过几次”，用完成时

questions.explanation: 问去过的次数，用 How many times have you been to…
